If valid: L2 = max(|c0-c1|^2, |c2-c1|^2) over XZ of the own car corners [ctrl+0x38]+0x1b0/+0x1c0/+0x1d0, heading wrapped to +-pi, ext = sqrt(L2*(1-cos^2)) + |cos * [ctrl+0x38]+0x30| (projected footprint at that heading); else ext = [ctrl+0x38]+0x30. In Ai_Lateral_AddOpponentIntervals both results become min/max and go into Ai_Interval_AddWeightedRange as [x1,x2].
